title: KVKK notice
intro: The information notice required under Turkish personal data protection law.

children.text: This notice is given under Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data (KVKK), which governs the processing of personal data in Türkiye.
We are registered in Ghana and operate in Türkiye. Turkish law can apply to processing carried out through that activity, and we would rather give you this notice than argue about whether we had to.
MAK Minaret Enterprise, registered in Ghana, operating in Ghana and Türkiye. Contact details are on the contact page.

To answer your enquiry, to advise you, and, on your instruction, to prepare and submit an application and support enrolment and residence formalities. The basis is the explicit consent you give when you submit.

Your identity and contact details, your educational background, and the content of your enquiry. Where you instruct us to apply, the relevant details go to the institution and to the authorities responsible for recognition, visa and residence.

You may learn whether your data is processed, request information about it, learn its purpose and whether it is used accordingly, know who it has been transferred to, request correction or deletion, object to conclusions drawn by automated analysis, and claim compensation for damage caused by unlawful processing.
Requests go to the email address on our contact page and are answered within 30 days.

Whether VERBİS registration applies to us, and whether registration with the Ghanaian or Nigerian data protection authorities applies, are being confirmed with our advisers. This notice is updated when they are.
